title: Why Do Starlings Form Giant Murmurations? 🐦 #Shorts
description:
Why do starlings form murmurations? Thousands of birds swirl into giant shapes at dusk — and there is NO leader.
Each starling only copies its seven closest neighbors. Scientists say the giant starling murmuration shape confuses hunting falcons, but why exactly birds flock this way is still a mystery.
